papers.title: On-Treatment Grade 3-4 Neutropenia and Clinical Outcomes with Trifluridine/Tipiracil in Refractory Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: ReTrITA Real-World Evidence
papers.authors: Signorelli C, Basso M, Anghelone A, Calegari M, Passardi A, Gallio C
papers.abstract: Background: Trifluridine/tipiracil (T) is a standard treatment for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). In randomized trials, treatment-emergent neutropenia has been associated with improved outcomes, suggesting a potential link with drug activity. However, evidence from routine clinical practice remains limited. This sub-analysis of the multicenter ReTrITA study evaluated the association between severe neutropenia and clinical outcomes in a real-world setting. Methods: Patients with refractory mCRC treated with T within the ReTrITA cohort were included. Patients were stratified according to the occurrence of grade 3-4 neutropenia. Overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared with the log-rank test. Hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using Cox models. Results: Among 843 patients, 271 (32.1%) developed grade 3-4 neutropenia. The occurrence of severe neutropenia was significantly associated with improved survival outcomes. Median OS was 10.9 months versus 7.6 months, HR 0.64; 95% CI, 0.55-0.75; p < 0.0001), and median PFS was 4.3 months versus 3.3 months (HR 0.63; 95% CI, 0.55-0.73; p < 0.0001) in patients with versus without neutropenia, respectively. Conclusions: In this large real-world cohort, grade 3-4 neutropenia during T treatment was associated with significantly improved OS and PFS, supporting its role as a potential on-treatment prognostic marker. Prospective studies are warranted to confirm these findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Trifluridine/tipiracil（T）是難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）的標準治療藥物。在隨機試驗中，治療相關性嗜中性球低下與較佳的治療結果有關，暗示其可能與藥物活性有關聯。然而，來自常規臨床實務的證據仍然有限。此為多中心ReTrITA研究之次分析，評估在真實世界情境中，嚴重嗜中性球低下與臨床結果之間的關聯。方法：納入ReTrITA世代中接受T治療的難治性mCRC病人，依是否發生第3-4級嗜中性球低下分組。以Kaplan-Meier法估計總生存期（OS）與無惡化存活期（PFS），並以log-rank檢定比較。以Cox模型計算風險比（HR）與95%信賴區間（CI）。結果：在843名病人中，271名（32.1%）發生第3-4級嗜中性球低下。嚴重嗜中性球低下的發生與較佳的生存結果顯著相關。有無嗜中性球低下病人的中位OS分別為10.9個月對7.6個月（HR 0.64；95% CI，0.55-0.75；p < 0.0001），中位PFS分別為4.3個月對3.3個月（HR 0.63；95% CI，0.55-0.73；p < 0.0001）。結論：在此大型真實世界世代中，T治療期間發生第3-4級嗜中性球低下與顯著改善的OS及PFS相關，支持其作為潛在治療中預後標記的角色。仍需前瞻性研究證實此發現。

papers.title: The potential connection between inflammatory bowel disease and Alzheimer's disease: mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications
papers.authors: Peng L, Wu Z, Yuan X, Zhou C, Fu H
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and Alzheimer's disease (AD) are two chronic conditions previously considered pathologically unrelated. However, accumulating epidemiological evidence suggests that patients with IBD may have an elevated risk. This review systematically analyzes the mechanistic links between IBD and AD, emphasizing the roles of gut microbiota dysbiosis, systemic and neuroinflammation, and glymphatic dysfunction. We propose a putative conceptual framework incorporating the 'gut-glymphatic axis' as a potential conduit through which IBD-associated microbial and immune perturbations may influence AD pathology. Key pathways include short-chain fatty acids, tryptophan metabolites, trimethylamine N-oxide, and bile acids, all of which modulate neuroinflammation and amyloid-β clearance. Additionally, circadian disruption and impaired aquaporin-4 polarity in the glymphatic system may represent novel links between intestinal inflammation and neurodegenerative changes. Preclinical animal models suggest that colitis exacerbates AD-like pathology via NLRP3 inflammasome activation, neutrophil infiltration, and microglial dysfunction. Natural bioactive compounds-such as ginsenosides, curcumin, baicalin, berberine, and magnolol-show dual therapeutic potential in both IBD and AD by targeting shared inflammatory and microbiota pathways. However, validated comorbidity models and clinical trials are lacking. This review provides a scientifically grounded basis for future mechanistic studies and integrated interventions for IBD-AD comorbidity.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病與阿茲海默症之間的潛在關聯：機轉洞見與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）與阿茲海默症（AD）過去被認為是兩種病理上無關的慢性疾病。然而，累積的流行病學證據顯示，IBD患者可能有較高的（阿茲海默症）風險。本綜述系統性分析IBD與AD之間的機轉關聯，強調腸道菌群失衡、全身性與神經發炎、以及類淋巴系統功能障礙的角色。我們提出一個假設性概念架構，納入「腸-類淋巴軸」作為IBD相關微生物與免疫擾動可能影響AD病理的潛在通道。關鍵路徑包括短鏈脂肪酸、色胺酸代謝物、氧化三甲胺、以及膽酸，這些皆可調節神經發炎與類澱粉蛋白清除。此外，晝夜節律紊亂與類淋巴系統中水通道蛋白-4極性受損，可能是腸道發炎與神經退化性變化之間的新關聯。臨床前動物模型顯示，結腸炎透過NLRP3發炎小體活化、嗜中性球浸潤、以及微膠細胞功能障礙而加劇AD樣病理。天然生物活性化合物——如人參皂苷、薑黃素、黃芩苷、小檗鹼、厚朴酚——透過標靶共同的發炎與菌群路徑，在IBD與AD中皆展現雙重治療潛力。然而，目前仍缺乏經驗證的共病模型與臨床試驗。本綜述為未來機轉研究與IBD-AD共病整合介入提供科學基礎。

papers.title: Prebiotic and Chemopreventive Potential of Digested Cooked Huitlacoche (Ustilago maydis) in Human HT-29 Colon Cancer Cells
papers.authors: Rebollar-García A, Luzardo-Ocampo I, Arvizu-Medrano S, Pool H, Loarca-Piña G, Velásquez-Jiménez D
papers.abstract: Huitlacoche (Ustilago maydis) is a popular and widely consumed edible fungus that infects corn, inducing gall formation rich in phenolic compounds. During consumption, huitlacoche-based phenolic compounds are affected by gastrointestinal conditions, thereby altering their bioaccessibility and, in turn, their prebiotic and chemopreventive potential. This study investigated the in vitro chemopreventive effects of cooked huitlacoche on human colon cancer cells (HT-29) and its prebiotic potential. Cooked huitlacoche underwent in vitro gastrointestinal digestion, followed by colonic fermentation, to evaluate the bioaccessibility of phenolic compounds and antioxidant capacity at each stage. The prebiotic potential was monitored by Lactobacillus gasseri growth in the presence of the nondigestible fraction of huitlacoche (NDF-H). Additionally, the chemopreventive effect of the colonic fermentation extract of huitlacoche (FE-H) was evaluated on HT-29 colon cancer cells. The cooking process increased (p < 0.05) total dietary fiber (+9.60%) while reducing other micronutrients. The concentrations of selected phenolic compounds increase during the gastric phase (benzoic acid: 265-fold; and 4-hydroxybenzoic acid: 19.13-fold). During in vitro human-gut colonic fermentation, acetic, propionic, and butyric acids were detected (up to 3.06-7.08 mmol/L). FE-H induced cytotoxic effects in HT-29 cells (LC50: 33.34% v/v) due to necrosis and caspase-3/7 activation, without being cytotoxic in human non-tumoral Hs 738 St./int. Moreover, digested huitlacoche promoted L. gasseri growth. Overall, cooked huitlacoche components are bioaccessible during in vitro gastrointestinal digestion and suggest chemopreventive and prebiotic potential. PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS: The consumption of cooked huitlacoche may have beneficial effects, supporting its classification as a functional food with chemopreventive and prebiotic properties. These properties stem from the dietary fiber content and antioxidant compounds.
papers.title_zh: 消化後熟胭脂霉（Ustilago maydis）對人類HT-29大腸癌細胞之益生元與化學預防潛力研究
papers.abstract_zh: 胭脂霉（Ustilago maydis）是一種廣受食用的真菌，會感染玉米並誘發富含酚類化合物之膨大組織（黑穗病癌）。食用過程中，胭脂霉來源之酚類化合物會受胃腸道條件影響，改變其生物可利用性，進而影響其益生元與化學預防潛力。本研究探討熟胭脂霉對人類大腸癌細胞（HT-29）的體外化學預防效果及其益生元潛力。熟胭脂霉經體外胃腸消化後接續進行結腸發酵，以評估各階段酚類化合物之生物可利用性與抗氧化能力。益生元潛力則透過在胭脂霉非消化部分（NDF-H）存在下觀察嗜酸乳桿菌（Lactobacillus gasseri）之生長情況來監測。此外，也評估胭脂霉結腸發酵萃取物（FE-H）對HT-29大腸癌細胞之化學預防效果。烹煮過程使總膳食纖維增加（+9.60%，p<0.05），同時降低其他微量營養素。特定酚類化合物濃度於胃相階段顯著增加（苯甲酸：增加265倍；4-羥基苯甲酸：增加19.13倍）。體外人類腸道結腸發酵過程中，檢測到乙酸、丙酸與丁酸（濃度達3.06-7.08 mmol/L）。FE-H對HT-29細胞誘發細胞毒性效應（LC50：33.34% v/v），機制與壞死及caspase-3/7活化有關，且對人類非腫瘤性Hs 738 St./int細胞無細胞毒性。此外，消化後之胭脂霉可促進嗜酸乳桿菌生長。整體而言，熟胭脂霉成分於體外胃腸消化過程中具生物可利用性，並顯示具化學預防與益生元潛力。實務應用：食用熟胭脂霉可能具有益處，支持其作為具化學預防與益生元特性之功能性食品的分類。此特性源於其膳食纖維含量與抗氧化化合物。

papers.title: A qualitative analysis of colon capsule endoscopy using a novel GP-led, home-delivered service model in the Western Isles, Scotland
papers.authors: Shearman T, Watson A, Macleod C
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: A novel GP-led, home-delivered colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) service was developed and delivered in the remote Western Isles, Scotland. This service model may address issues faced by rural dwellers in accessing traditional colonoscopies. Staff perspectives on the development, delivery and impact of this service model may assist decision-makers and future researchers in understanding the nuances of CCE delivery models in rural areas.
METHODS: An interview schedule was developed and participants were recruited from an estimated population of 27 staff members involved in the CCE service. Purposive sampling was used to ensure participants were from diverse job families and work locations, capturing the service from different perspectives. Participants undertook semi-structured interviews on Microsoft Teams between July and September 2024. We used an iterative grounded-theory approach to theme generation using broad interview topics as a guide to ensure the analysis met the research aims. Data were analysed using thematic analysis five-stage approach.
RESULTS: Eleven participants from Scotland's National Health Service (NHS) boards, including NHS Western Isles, NHS Highland and NHS National Services Scotland, underwent interview. Job families represented included medical, nursing and administrative. Participants identified unique enablers and barriers to the development and delivery of the service. The island's remote geography, for example, was an enabler in the development of the unique service model but occasionally a barrier during service delivery. Advantages and disadvantages were broadly grouped into those for patients, staff and the healthcare system. Advantages included reduced patient travel and improved job satisfaction. Participants did not identify significant risks with this service model. There was some uncertainty and disagreement regarding certain service impacts, including economic benefit and impacts on the endoscopy service.
DISCUSSION: Other services may find participant reflections on the enablers, barriers and risk management strategies of this service useful when considering similar changes. Participant reflections on their own experiences, including advantages and disadvantages for staff, can be taken at face value whereas reflections on the patient experience require further evaluation with patients themselves. There was uncertainty and disagreement about some of the impacts of the service and its economic benefit, where limited conclusions may be drawn without further research.
CONCLUSION: Our research identified key enablers and barriers to the development and delivery of GP-led, hospital-at-home delivered CCE in a remote part of Scotland. While participants expressed broad agreement about advantages and disadvantages of the service, including significant benefits for staff, some of these require further evaluation from the patient perspective. Similarly, there were areas where participants were uncertain or disagreed about the impact of the service, requiring further quantitative and economic evaluation.
papers.title_zh: 以質性分析探討蘇格蘭西部群島一種新型「家庭醫師主導、居家送達」大腸膠囊內視鏡（CCE）服務模式
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：在蘇格蘭偏遠的西部群島發展並執行了一種新型「家庭醫師主導、居家送達」大腸膠囊內視鏡（CCE）服務。此服務模式可能解決偏鄉居民在取得傳統大腸鏡檢查上所面臨的困難。工作人員對此服務模式之發展、執行與影響的觀點，或可協助決策者與未來研究者理解偏鄉地區CCE服務模式的細節。

方法：研究團隊設計訪談大綱，並自約27名參與CCE服務的工作人員中招募受訪者。採用立意抽樣以確保受訪者來自不同職類與工作地點，藉此從不同角度捕捉此服務。受訪者於2024年7月至9月間透過Microsoft Teams接受半結構式訪談。研究採用反覆進行的紮根理論取向進行主題生成，以廣泛的訪談主題作為指引，確保分析符合研究目的。資料以五階段主題分析法進行分析。

結果：來自蘇格蘭國民保健署（NHS）各委員會（包括NHS Western Isles、NHS Highland與NHS National Services Scotland）的11名參與者接受訪談，職類涵蓋醫療、護理與行政人員。參與者指出此服務發展與執行過程中的獨特促進因素與障礙。舉例而言，島嶼的偏遠地理環境在服務模式發展階段是促進因素，但在服務執行時偶爾成為障礙。優缺點大致可分為對病人、工作人員與醫療體系三方面。優點包括減少病人往返交通與提升工作人員工作滿意度。參與者並未指出此服務模式有重大風險。對於部分服務影響，包括經濟效益與對內視鏡服務的衝擊，存在一定程度的不確定性與意見分歧。

討論：其他單位在考慮類似變革時，或可參考本研究參與者對此服務促進因素、障礙與風險管理策略的反思。參與者對自身經驗（包括對工作人員的優缺點）的反思可直接採信，但對病人經驗的反思仍需進一步向病人本身進行評估。對於服務的部分影響及其經濟效益，存在不確定性與意見分歧，在缺乏進一步研究下僅能得出有限的結論。

結論：本研究確認了在蘇格蘭偏遠地區發展與執行「家庭醫師主導、居家式」CCE服務的關鍵促進因素與障礙。雖然參與者對此服務的優缺點（包括對工作人員的顯著益處）大致有共識，但部分益處仍需從病人角度進一步評估。同樣地，參與者對此服務的部分影響存在不確定性或意見分歧，需要進一步的量化與經濟評估研究。

papers.title: Global burden of esophagus cancer, stomach cancer and colon and rectal cancer from 1990 to 2050: A cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, and colon and rectal cancer (CRC), as the main components of gastrointestinal tract cancer (GTC), represent significant obstacles to reducing the global cancer burden. Therefore, obtaining an epidemiological characteristic of the 3 major GTCs is highly important. This study aims to analyze and forecast the changing trends in the burden of the 3 major GTCs, offering a certain theoretical foundation for cancer public health policymakers. The data utilized in this study were all sourced from the Global Burden of Disease study 2021. Specifically, the case numbers and age-standardized rate (ASR) for prevalence, death, and disability-adjusted life years of esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, and CRC were included. Additionally, the estimated annual percentage change of the 3 major GTCs was computed for the period spanning from 1990 to 2021 across 5 distinct socio-demographic index and 21 Global Burden of Disease regions. Moreover, a Bayesian age-period-cohort model was constructed to project the disease burden of the 3 major GTCs from 2022 to 2050. From 1990 to 2021, the number of cases of the 3 major GTCs showed an overall increasing trend. Regarding ASRs, with the exception of the increasing age-standardized prevalence rate of CRC, the ASRs of the remaining GTCs demonstrated a downward trend. The disease burden of the 3 GTCs was higher among males compared to females, predominantly affecting individuals aged 50 and above. The regions with notable ASRs of the 3 major GTCs were East Asia and high-income Asia. The prediction outcomes also suggested that, apart from the age-standardized prevalence rate of CRC, the burden of the 3 major GTCs might display a decreasing trend in the next 29 years. Although the ASRs of the 3 primary types of GTC exhibit a downward trend, the case counts of these types still maintain a relatively high baseline level. Consequently, conducting GTC screening in specific regions, developing relevant health policies and popularizing disease-related knowledge continue to hold critical significance.

papers.title_zh: 1990年至2050年全球食道癌、胃癌與大腸直腸癌（CRC）之疾病負擔：橫斷面研究
papers.abstract_zh: 食道癌、胃癌與大腸直腸癌（CRC）作為胃腸道癌症（GTC）的主要組成，是降低全球癌症負擔的重大障礙。因此，掌握這三大GTC的流行病學特徵極為重要。本研究旨在分析並預測這三大GTC疾病負擔的變化趨勢，為癌症公共衛生政策制定者提供理論基礎。本研究資料全數來自2021年全球疾病負擔研究（GBD 2021）。具體而言，納入了食道癌、胃癌與CRC之盛行率、死亡率及失能調整生命年（DALY）的病例數與年齡標準化率（ASR）。此外，計算了1990年至2021年間，跨5種不同社會人口指數（SDI）與21個GBD區域的三大GTC之估計年百分比變化（EAPC）。同時，建構貝氏年齡－時期－世代模型，以預測2022年至2050年三大GTC的疾病負擔。1990年至2021年間，三大GTC的病例數整體呈上升趨勢。就ASR而言，除CRC的年齡標準化盛行率呈上升趨勢外，其餘GTC的ASR均呈下降趨勢。三種GTC的疾病負擔在男性中均高於女性，且主要影響50歲以上族群。東亞與高收入亞洲地區三大GTC的ASR特別顯著。預測結果亦顯示，除CRC年齡標準化盛行率外，未來29年三大GTC的負擔可能呈下降趨勢。儘管三種主要GTC的ASR呈下降趨勢，其病例數仍維持相對高的基準水準。因此，在特定地區進行GTC篩檢、制定相關衛生政策及普及疾病相關知識，仍具有重要意義。

papers.title: A Novel Approach for Analyzing Non-Proportional Hazards With Long-Term Survivors: The Defective Yang-Prentice Model
papers.abstract: In survival analysis, addressing non-proportional hazards and the presence of long-term survivors poses substantial methodological challenges, as traditional models often fail to capture these features adequately. To overcome these limitations, a novel long-term survival model is proposed that integrates the Yang and Prentice framework with a defective Gompertz distribution. The proposed model provides a robust approach for analyzing time-to-event data with non-proportional hazards and a cure fraction. Comprehensive simulation studies and an application to colorectal cancer data illustrate its flexibility in capturing time-varying hazard ratios and long-term survivors, making it a useful alternative to existing methods.

papers.title: LncRNA SLC12A9-AS1 Drives Malignant Progression in Colorectal Cancer by Regulating miR-139-3p
papers.authors: Zhao S, Zhang S, Tan Q, Luo Y, Wu X
papers.abstract: This study investigated the function of long noncoding RNA SLC12A9-AS1 in colorectal cancer (CRC) cells and its potential regulatory mechanism. Reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) was used to measure SLC12A9-AS1 and miR-139-3p expression in CRC cell lines. Cell viability was assessed using the Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assay, whereas migration and invasion were evaluated using permeable cell culture insert assays. The interaction between SLC12A9-AS1 and miR-139-3p was examined using dual-luciferase reporter (DLR) and RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) assays. SLC12A9-AS1 was significantly upregulated, whereas miR-139-3p was downregulated, in CRC cells. Silencing SLC12A9-AS1 markedly reduced cell viability, migration, invasion, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). The DLR and RIP assays supported an interaction between SLC12A9-AS1 and miR-139-3p. In addition, inhibition of miR-139-3p reversed the suppressive effects of SLC12A9-AS1 knockdown on malignant cellular phenotypes. Collectively, these findings indicate that SLC12A9-AS1 is abnormally overexpressed in CRC cells and that its knockdown attenuates malignant phenotypes, at least in part through regulation of miR-139-3p. These results provide new in vitro experimental evidence for understanding the molecular mechanisms involved in CRC pathogenesis.

papers.title: A Phase II Clinical Trial of Chemotherapy Rechallenge with or without Targeted Therapy in Refractory Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Wang C, Huang M, Li W, Sheng X, Zhao X, Zhu X
papers.abstract: Background: Patients with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) face limited treatment options after failure of standard therapies. This single-arm, phase II study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of rechallenge strategies using previously effective regimens in late-line mCRC. Methods: Patients who progressed after ≥2 lines of prior chemotherapy, with a prior progression-free survival (PFS) ≥4 months and a ≥4-month treatment-free interval on that regimen were enrolled. Patients received rechallenge chemotherapy (oxaliplatin-, irinotecan-, or raltitrexed-based) with or without targeted agents (bevacizumab or cetuximab). Primary endpoint was investigator-assessed PFS. Secondary endpoints included objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), overall survival (OS), and safety. Results: Forty-three patients were enrolled (31 received chemotherapy plus targeted agents; 12 received chemotherapy alone). One patient discontinued treatment, leaving 42 patients evaluable for tumor response. The median PFS and OS were 3.97 months (95% CI: 2.46-5.48) and 13.03 months (95% CI: 9.68-16.38), respectively, while the ORR and DCR were 2.4% and 61.9%. Subgroup analysis showed that patients receiving chemotherapy plus targeted agents had higher DCRs (80.0% for bevacizumab-based regimens and 72.7% for cetuximab-based regimens vs. 18.2% for chemotherapy alone;) and longer median PFS (4.17 and 4.50 months vs. 1.57 months, respectively). Grade 3 or 4 adverse events were reported in 39.5% of patients, with no severe adverse events or treatment-related deaths observed. Conclusion: Chemotherapy rechallenge strategies, particularly when combined with targeted agents, demonstrated promising clinical activity and acceptable safety in selected heavily pretreated patients with mCRC who previously achieved sustained disease control.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）病人在標準治療失敗後治療選擇有限。本單臂第二期研究旨在評估晚線mCRC病人使用先前有效方案進行「再挑戰」策略之療效與安全性。方法：納入條件為先前接受≥2線化療後疾病惡化、該方案先前無惡化存活期（PFS）≥4個月、且該方案治療空窗期≥4個月之病人。病人接受再挑戰化療（以oxaliplatin、irinotecan或raltitrexed為基礎），併用或不併用標靶藥物（bevacizumab或cetuximab）。主要終點為研究者評估之PFS，次要終點包括客觀反應率（ORR）、疾病控制率（DCR）、整體存活（OS）及安全性。結果：共納入43名病人（31人接受化療合併標靶藥物；12人僅接受化療）。1名病人中止治療，42名病人可評估腫瘤反應。中位PFS為3.97個月（95% CI: 2.46–5.48），中位OS為13.03個月（95% CI: 9.68–16.38），ORR為2.4%，DCR為61.9%。亞群分析顯示，接受化療合併標靶藥物之病人DCR較高（bevacizumab方案組80.0%、cetuximab方案組72.7% vs 化療單獨組18.2%），中位PFS也較長（分別為4.17個月與4.50個月 vs 1.57個月）。39.5%病人發生3或4級不良事件，未觀察到嚴重不良事件或治療相關死亡。結論：化療再挑戰策略，尤其合併標靶藥物時，在經篩選、曾達持續疾病控制之重度預治療mCRC病人中，展現出令人期待的臨床活性與可接受之安全性。

papers.title: PSMB9 Promotes the Malignant Progression of Colorectal Cancer by Regulating the PI3K/Akt Pathway
papers.authors: Gao W, Zheng X, Hu Y, Zou R, Zhou Y, Song X
papers.abstract: Background: As a core component of the immunoproteasome, the β1i subunit (proteasome 20S subunit beta 9, PSMB9) is involved in antigen processing and presentation and regulates anti-tumor immune responses. PSMB9 is aberrantly overexpressed in colorectal cancer. However, the precise mechanisms through which PSMB9 contributes to the initiation, progression, and immune regulation of colorectal cancer remain unclear. This study aims to investigate the expression characteristics and biological functions of PSMB9 in colorectal cancer, and to further elucidate the molecular pathways underlying its role in colorectal cancer initiation and progression. The findings are expected to provide a theoretical basis for the development of targeted therapeutic strategies against colorectal cancer. Methods: PSMB9 expression in colorectal cancer was analyzed using the TCGA, GEO, GEPIA, and HPA databases, and further validated in normal colonic epithelial cells and colorectal cancer cell lines by RT-qPCR and Western blot. Lentiviral transduction was used to establish stably transduced HCT116 and SW480 cell lines with PSMB9 knockdown and overexpression, respectively. Cell proliferation, migration, and invasion were assessed by CCK-8, colony formation, wound healing, and Transwell assays. Key proteins of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway were detected by Western blot. Results: PSMB9 was significantly upregulated at both the mRNA and protein levels in colorectal cancer tissues and cell lines. PSMB9 knockdown significantly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion of colorectal cancer cells, while overexpression enhanced these malignant phenotypes. Mechanistically, PSMB9 exerted oncogenic effects through activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Conclusions: PSMB9 promotes the malignant progression of colorectal cancer by regulating the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

papers.title_zh: PSMB9 透過調控 PI3K/Akt 訊息路徑促進大腸直腸癌之惡性進展
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：作為免疫蛋白酶體的核心組成成分，β1i 次單元（蛋白酶體20S次單元beta 9，PSMB9）參與抗原處理與呈現，並調控抗腫瘤免疫反應。PSMB9 在大腸直腸癌中異常過度表現。然而，PSMB9 促進大腸直腸癌起始、進展及免疫調控的確切機制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探討 PSMB9 在大腸直腸癌中的表現特徵與生物學功能，並進一步闡明其在大腸直腸癌起始與進展中所涉及的分子路徑。研究結果預期為開發針對大腸直腸癌的靶向治療策略提供理論基礎。方法：利用 TCGA、GEO、GEPIA 及 HPA 資料庫分析 PSMB9 在大腸直腸癌中的表現，並以 RT-qPCR 及 Western blot 於正常大腸上皮細胞與大腸直腸癌細胞株中進一步驗證。使用慢病毒轉導技術於 HCT116 與 SW480 細胞株中分別建立穩定表現 PSMB9 knockdown 及過度表現之細胞株。以 CCK-8、colony formation、wound healing 及 Transwell 試驗評估細胞增殖、遷移及侵襲能力。以 Western blot 偵測 PI3K/Akt 訊息路徑之關鍵蛋白。結果：PSMB9 在大腸直腸癌組織與細胞株中，mRNA 與蛋白質層級皆顯著上調。PSMB9 knockdown 顯著抑制大腸直腸癌細胞之增殖、遷移及侵襲，而過度表現則增強這些惡性表型。機制上，PSMB9 透過活化 PI3K/Akt 訊息路徑發揮致癌作用。結論：PSMB9 透過調控 PI3K/Akt 訊息路徑促進大腸直腸癌之惡性進展。

papers.title: Differential Tumor Response and Conversion Outcomes Associated with First-Line Biologic Strategies in Liver-Limited RAS Wild-Type Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Chiang S, Chen M, Lin C, Huang Y, Chiang F, Yang S
papers.abstract: Background: Anti-EGFR therapy is widely used as first-line treatment for RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC), particularly in patients with left-sided tumors. In liver-limited disease, maximizing tumor shrinkage may facilitate conversion to resectability; however, comparative real-world evidence among panitumumab, cetuximab, and bevacizumab remains limited. This study aimed to compare the clinical outcomes of these biologic agents in patients with RAS wild-type mCRC. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 241 patients with RAS wild-type mCRC treated with first-line chemotherapy plus panitumumab (n = 76), cetuximab (n = 80), or bevacizumab (n = 85) between 2016 and 2024. Outcomes included depth of response (DpR), objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), conversion surgery rate, progression-free survival (PFS), and overall survival (OS). Results: Overall, panitumumab demonstrated superior tumor response, achieving the highest ORR (69.7%) and conversion surgery rate (34.2%), although PFS and OS were comparable among treatment groups. In patients with liver-limited disease, panitumumab was associated with a higher conversion surgery rate than bevacizumab (50.0% vs. 19.4%) and a trend toward longer OS. Right-sided primary tumors and BRAF mutation remained independent predictors of poorer OS. Conclusions: Panitumumab-based therapy was associated with deeper tumor shrinkage and higher conversion rates, particularly in liver-limited mCRC. These findings suggest that greater cytoreduction may increase opportunities for local treatment in selected patients. However, given the retrospective nature of the study, the findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and require prospective validation.

papers.title_zh: 肝臟局限型RAS野生型轉移性大腸直腸癌：不同一線生物製劑策略之腫瘤反應差異與轉換手術結果
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Anti-EGFR治療廣泛用於RAS野生型轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）之一線治療，特別是左側腫瘤病人。在肝臟局限疾病中，最大化腫瘤縮小可能有助於轉換為可切除性；然而，panitumumab、cetuximab與bevacizumab三者之真實世界比較證據仍有限。本研究旨在比較這些生物製劑在RAS野生型mCRC病人中的臨床結果。方法：我們回溯性分析2016至2024年間接受一線化療併用panitumumab（n=76）、cetuximab（n=80）或bevacizumab（n=85）治療之241名RAS野生型mCRC病人。結果指標包括反應深度（DpR）、客觀反應率（ORR）、疾病控制率（DCR）、轉換手術率、無惡化存活期（PFS）與整體存活期（OS）。結果：整體而言，panitumumab展現最優異的腫瘤反應，達到最高ORR（69.7%）與轉換手術率（34.2%），但各治療組間PFS與OS相當。在肝臟局限疾病病人中，panitumumab之轉換手術率高於bevacizumab（50.0% vs. 19.4%），且OS呈現較長之趨勢。右側原發腫瘤與BRAF突變仍為較差OS之獨立預測因子。結論：以panitumumab為基礎之治療與更深的腫瘤縮小及更高的轉換率相關，尤其在肝臟局限型mCRC中。這些發現顯示更大程度的細胞減積可能增加特定病人接受局部治療的機會。然而，鑑於本研究之回溯性性質，這些發現應被視為假說產生性質，需要前瞻性驗證。
papers.score_reason: 回溯性、非隨機分配藥物之三臂比較，肝限局亞組樣本可能存在選擇偏差，作者自承為假說產生性研究，需前瞻驗證。
papers.relevance_why: 直接涉及大腸直腸外科最關心的肝臟局限轉移性大腸癌轉換手術決策與生物製劑選擇。
papers.one_liner: 在241名RAS wild-type mCRC病人中，比較panitumumab、cetuximab、bevacizumab一線治療，panitumumab轉換手術率最高（34.2%），肝限局病人達50.0% vs bevacizumab 19.4%。
papers.action: 目前不需改變一線用藥選擇；MDT討論邊緣可切除肝轉移病人時可納入此假說性資料參考，仍待前瞻性試驗驗證。

pico.P: 241名RAS野生型mCRC病人，2016-2024接受一線化療併生物製劑（panitumumab 76人、cetuximab 80人、bevacizumab 85人）
